name: singlet_markers_de_lfc_shrinkage_effect_size
title: Shrink log fold changes and rank genes by effect size
description: Shrinks per-gene log2 fold changes for one contrast from donor-level pseudobulk counts using empirical-Bayes posteriors, returning shrunken estimates, intervals, lfsr and s-values. Use the default apeglm to rank genes by effect size; mle gives unshrunk estimates and seurat_avg_log2fc or scanpy_logfc are heuristic comparators only. A donor column is required, so cell-level input without donors is refused. Writes varm and uns members for the contrast; it does not compute p-values.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Raw count layer summed into pseudobulk samples.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing LFC output members for this contrast instead of failing.

method.description: Shrinkage method. apeglm is the default; seurat and scanpy methods are unshrunk comparators.

contrast.description: Test level compared with a reference level, optionally within strata.

test.description: Level whose expression is compared with the reference.

reference.description: Denominator level of the log fold change.

donor_column.description: obs column with biological replicate (donor) identifiers.

cell_type_column.description: obs column defining strata; null pools all cells.

min_umis.description: Minimum total UMIs per pseudobulk sample.

min_gene_umis.description: Genes with fewer total UMIs across samples are not ranked.

svalue.description: Compute lfsr and s-values; applies to apeglm and ashr only.

prior_scale.description: Cauchy prior scale; null adapts it to the MLE spread, capped at 1.

interval_type.description: Interval construction for the apeglm posterior.

mixcompdist.description: Mixture component family; normal matches the DESeq2 call.

pseudocount.description: Pseudocount added to group sums of normalised counts.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. varm/lfc_shrunk_<contrast>. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Method, pseudobulk sample count, ranked gene count, apeglm prior scale, and genes with lfsr at or below 0.05.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
